## Community Blog post

Thank you for writing for the Kubuntu Community Blog!

### Checklist

- [ ] Post lives under `content/en/blog/` (not `news/`)
- [ ] Frontmatter includes **`author`** (display name shown in the byline)
- [ ] Frontmatter includes **`author_slug`** (stable id, lowercase-hyphenated, e.g. `jane-doe`)
- [ ] Optional `author_url` is a public profile/homepage if you want it linked
- [ ] `draft: false` when ready to publish
- [ ] Clearly community voice — not presented as a Kubuntu Council statement
- [ ] Points readers to Discourse for discussion where appropriate
- [ ] Marked if this is a seed/example post being replaced
